name: Arkansh Sharma
title: MBBS Candidate & Neurology Research Intern
intro: This site collects working notes, partial results, and commentary that accompany ongoing research in neurology and computational neuroscience. It is meant to be read alongside the papers, not instead of them.
bio: I'm a medical student at Government Medical College, Omandurar, currently working as a research intern in the Albers Lab at Harvard Medical School and Massachusetts General Hospital. My work sits at the intersection of clinical neurology and machine learning — olfactory biomarkers of neurodegeneration, EEG-based classification, and large-scale meta-analyses across stroke, epilepsy, and dementia.
